name: Chicago
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is warm and lively, with the lakefront in full use; winters are genuinely brutal, among the coldest of any major US city.
overview: The birthplace of the skyscraper — world-class architecture best seen from a river cruise, deep dish pizza, and a Lake Michigan waterfront packed every summer.
costOverview: Deep dish and hot dogs are cheap for a major US city — the Magnificent Mile's shopping and top-tier restaurants are where costs climb.
